items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: INTERVIEWER: It was T Holder that I wanted to ask you about. Did you ever hear T Holder's band out of Texas? ... [INTERVIEWEE]: Never heard of them.

ctx.x: Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Was another Larry not here? Jimmy. Jimmy Larry. He did. The, the, the, the cornet player had the band. Larry inherited that band from his brother. Oh. Jimmy Larry had the band. Did you ever hear a Don Albums band? Yeah, I know. They were, they came in, they came here in the early, early thirties too. Alvin Alcon was in that band. Got a trombone player named Geechee. I can't talk about the name of Fernandez. I believe he's from here. Fred Nandese, huh? Yeah, I know something like that. Yeah,…
Yeah. All that kind of stuff. It was T Holder that I wanted to ask you about. Did you ever hear T Holder's band out of Texas? Never heard of them. They're supposed to be tough. I think he

sort of tied up with some of the Kansas City guys. I heard Alcon's, Alcon's Trent. Oh yeah? That was a good band. He came out of Texas. Did he come here? Uh-huh. Trent. Did he come to New Orleans? Yeah, Trent. Trent came here. Well, when did he come here? I'm trying to remember when he was. Trent came here in the middle thirties. I can't remember when he went down. Trent came here. Milton Larkins. Oh yeah. Milton Larkins was here every week. Carolina Cotton Pickers.
